คลินิกเดนทัลไบรท์ Dental Bright Clinic@Ratchada
text: Here, the assistant refused treatment because I have psoriasis, fearing I would infect my child. Even though we explained that psoriasis is not contagious, she still looked worried. Anyone planning to go here should inform them of their medical conditions beforehand, as cases are considered differently than elsewhere. Overall, I was very dissatisfied with the assistant's words and felt terrible. At least she could have Googled what this disease is and whether it's contagious before saying anything. Oh, and importantly, the doctor was not punctual; my appointment was at 7:30 PM, but they arrived at 8:00 PM.

text: Terrible experience. I called to inquire about the cost and was quoted 200฿. The next day, I went to the clinic but they said the doctor wasn't there and told me to come back tomorrow. I said okay and double-checked if that was the correct price, and they said yes (200฿). Other clinics charge 250-260฿, so I thought it was 200฿ and decided to go ahead with it. Then, the next day, they added another 100฿, making it 300฿ in total. I asked why they didn't inform me beforehand, and they didn't answer. This is unacceptable. I was looking for a clinic with reasonable prices, but this kind of treatment is unacceptable.
